summary: Iter78 (Team Music + Seasons Phase 2 scope + Schedule conflicts) tested against the external URL. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases PASSED — Team Music full flow (init → chunked base64 chunks → finish assembles to GridFS → list → token-authenticated stream roundtrip returns identical bytes → PATCH title/team_ids → DELETE removes track and it disappears from list), stream 401 on bad and missing token, 15MB size cap enforced (16MB upload rejected at finish), chunk upload 404 on unknown track_id, Seasons scoped edits: athlete edit_scope='this' correctly forks a new season-specific record while the original keeps the other season; PATCH with season_ids and no edit_scope updates membership in place; same fork-behavior verified for /api/competitions/{id} and /api/teams/{id}; and schedule PATCH accepts season_ids. Frontend (Expo Web, 390x844): login OK → Team Hub → Team Music tool card (testID team-tool-music) visible → routes to /team/music which renders header, back button, upload button (testID music-upload), and empty state with 'Upload a track' CTA (music-upload-empty). No red screen, no console errors on music screen. Schedule tab loads with 0 conflict badges (no overlapping events currently seeded — badge testID schedule-conflict-<id> confirmed present in code at (tabs)/schedule.tsx). SeasonPicker chips (season-chip-<id>) render on athletes/new and competitions/new; scope selector (season-scope-this/forward/all) confirmed present in SeasonPicker.tsx and correctly gated by parent forms (showScope={isEdit && origSeasonIds.length > 1}) so it does NOT appear for the fresh test account whose items are in ≤1 season — this matches spec. All ephemeral test data cleaned up. Twilio was NOT touched.

minor.issue: Previously threw 500 when payload omitted `photos` and `season_ids` (ScheduleEventCreate has Optional[List]=None which failed ScheduleEvent's list validation). FIXED in routers/schedule.py:31-38 by normalizing None → [] for photos/season_ids/athlete_ids/links before ScheduleEvent(**base). Verified with pytest.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/music.py stream endpoint (line 145-177) requires token via query string only and enforces both bearer validation via _user_from_token AND a fresh team_access DB check — good defense-in-depth. `Accept-Ranges: none` header disables seeking; if long tracks (>5 min) require scrubbing on iOS Safari, consider adding range support later, but not required for MVP.

routers/music.py finish_upload (line 95-98) correctly wipes chunks + track on oversize, but does NOT wipe partial chunks if the client abandons mid-upload — potentially long-lived orphans. Consider a periodic cleanup job for `music_chunks` older than 1 hour.

routers/music.py upload_chunk stores `data: str(data)` in Mongo (line 74). If client accidentally sends the wrong content-type (e.g., bytes), coercion still happens but silently. Not a bug; documented.

core/helpers.apply_scoped_update (line 478-522) correctly no-ops when scope='all' or item is in 0/1 seasons or active season isn't among the item's seasons; fork case builds a proper UUID copy and detaches season_ids from the original. Behavior is symmetric across athletes/competitions/teams (all use the same helper). Confirmed by backend tests.

routers/schedule.py POST previously blew up on None-valued Optional[List] fields. Fixed via inline normalization. Suggest doing the same defensive coercion in the model layer (custom validator) if similar issues appear in other Create→Full model conversions.

frontend/app/team/music.tsx uses expo-audio (`useAudioPlayer`, `useAudioPlayerStatus`) — correct modern package (not deprecated expo-av). Chunked base64 upload with CHUNK=720000 (divisible by 4) is a solid choice. Progress bar and cancel behavior look fine. Playback on web preview cannot be exercised end-to-end (Chrome will attempt to fetch stream URL); it should work but not fully validated here.
updated_files: /app/backend/routers/schedule.py (POST /api/schedule: normalize None Optional[List] fields to [] before ScheduleEvent construction)

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (Team Music screen loads with upload buttons; Team tab shows music tool card; athletes/new + competitions/new render SeasonPicker; schedule tab renders — no red screens)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only: two TEST_ITER78 seasons, a few TEST_ITER78 athletes/competitions/teams/schedule events, and Team Music tracks (64KB and a rejected 16MB attempt) — all cleaned up in the same test that created them (the 16MB attempt is cleaned server-side per the finish endpoint's over-limit branch).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: /login uses testIDs login-email-input, login-password-input; submit by clicking `Sign in` text (page.get_by_text('Sign in', exact=True).first.click(force=True)) — Enter-key triggers 401. Login redirects to /dashboard (use wait_for_url('**/dashboard**')). Team Music: /team/music has testIDs music-back, music-upload, music-upload-empty (empty state), music-track-<id>, music-play-<id>, music-edit-<id>, music-delete-<id>, and modal music-title-input + music-save + music-team-<id> + music-comp-<id>. Streaming URL: {BACKEND}/api/team/music/{id}/stream?token={jwt}. 15MB cap enforced at finish, not at chunk. SeasonPicker scope selector (season-scope-this/forward/all) only renders when parent passes showScope=true AND onScopeChange — parent forms gate it on origSeasonIds.length>1 && isEdit, so the fresh review account needs an item in ≥2 seasons to see it (easiest way is create/attach in-place, then reopen edit). Schedule conflict badge (schedule-conflict-<id>) requires two events with the same date + overlapping start_time/end_time ranges. Backend POST /api/schedule now tolerates missing photos/season_ids/athlete_ids/links keys (recently fixed in this iter).
